direction.premise: Property table lists animation type not animatable; computed value is specified value.

writing-mode.premise: Property table lists animation type not animatable; computed value is specified value.

taint.premise: Use in keyframes taints the custom property; a referencing custom property also becomes tainted.

substitution.premise: Step 3 rejects a tainted named custom property in a non-animatable destination; step 4 uses the supplied fallback.

scope: Substitution oracle; no native implementation or first-flush algorithm proof.
